note: Client-side copy deterrents. Settings form route copyprevention.settings_form (/admin/config/user-interface/copyprevention), permissions 'administer copy prevention' and 'bypass copy prevention'. All state in config object copyprevention.settings: copyprevention_body (checkboxes selectstart/copy/contextmenu -> body on<x>='return false'), copyprevention_images (contextmenu/transparentgif), copyprevention_images_min_dimension (int, default 150), copyprevention_images_search (httpheader/pagehead/robotstxt; robotstxt needs the RobotsTxt module). Enabled = truthy value at the option key (unchecked stored as 0). Medium cases read a seeded body option and the seeded min dimension; hard cases enable the right-click deterrent and the noimageindex meta tag, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site, which module lets me disable right-click and text selection to make copying harder, and where do I configure it?
evals.expected_output: The Copy Prevention module. Configure it at Configuration > User interface > Copy Prevention (/admin/config/user-interface/copyprevention, route copyprevention.settings_form). Tick the body options to disable text selection, copy, and/or the right-click context menu.

evals.prompt: Using copyprevention, how do I stop search engines from indexing my images, and which option needs another module?
evals.expected_output: Under 'Protect/hide images from search engines' (config copyprevention_images_search) enable the X-Robots-Tag: noimageindex header (httpheader), the noimageindex robots meta tag (pagehead), and/or robots.txt image Disallow rules (robotstxt). The robots.txt option requires the RobotsTxt module.

evals.prompt: In the copyprevention module, how do I make sure my editors/admins are not affected by the copy deterrents? Is it truly secure?
evals.expected_output: Grant the 'bypass copy prevention' permission to trusted roles; _copyprevention_is_enabled() returns FALSE for them so no body attributes/JS are attached. It is only a client-side deterrent (view-source, devtools and direct image URLs still work), not real protection.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has copyprevention configured. Inspect the live copyprevention.settings and state which body-level protection(s) are currently enabled (text selection, copy, and/or right-click context menu).
evals.expected_output: In copyprevention.settings, copyprevention_body has copy and contextmenu enabled (selectstart is off), i.e. copy-to-clipboard and the right-click context menu are disabled.

evals.prompt: The copyprevention image overlay is active on this site. Inspect the live configuration and report the minimum image dimension (in pixels) at which the transparent-GIF overlay kicks in.
evals.expected_output: copyprevention.settings.copyprevention_images_min_dimension is 300, so only images larger than 300px get the transparent-GIF overlay (transparentgif is enabled).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the copyprevention module to disable the right-click context menu across the whole site (the body-level context-menu deterrent), and save the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: In copyprevention.settings the copyprevention_body option 'contextmenu' is set to a truthy value (e.g. tick 'Disable right-click context menu' on the settings form, or set copyprevention_body['contextmenu']='contextmenu' and save).

evals.prompt: Using copyprevention on this site, hide images from search engines by adding the 'noimageindex' robots meta tag to the page head, and apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: In copyprevention.settings the copyprevention_images_search option 'pagehead' is set to a truthy value, which makes hook_page_attachments() add <meta name="robots" content="noimageindex"> to the page head.
